summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, furnishing the notice of its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for July 28, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: re-appointment of auditors, re-election of two directors, and approval of the CEO's engagement. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is a standard corporate governance update with no transaction, strategic review, or capital returns event.
